findings.finding: Bỏ qua thông báo: sibling “Dismiss … notice” labels (ui.browser.browser_passkey_notice.dismiss, ui.browser.browser_file_transfer_row.dismiss_download_notice/_upload_notice, ui.common.updates.update_quiet_indicator.dismiss_update_notice, ui.settings.configuration…dismiss_this_notice) all use Ẩn (Ẩn thông báo khóa truy cập, …); Bỏ qua matches this band's prompt_dismiss and ui.common.actions.dismiss. Accessible name only. Optional: Ẩn thông báo. No change.
Button name Cho phép is unquoted (every arm); “Cho phép” would read clearer. Same call as round-1 VI-N3. No change.

Cài đặt hệ thống › Quyền riêng tư & Bảo mật equals the audited media_permission hint and core vi cli.permissions; no agent term in this namespace (glossary tác nhân not exercised); pronoun dropped per guide except one natural Có thể bạn cần.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). Names the device(s) explicitly (micrô / camera / camera và micrô), matching the band's device terms; no pronoun needed.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-vi at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
